ctx.x: The tuxedo man was, the way I was in it, was Southern Stan, Shots, and the Pajot, and the trumpets. And the little Aranza, the teal, and the. And August Russo, on Tramon, Sonny, on Tramon, and old man Taton. Old man Taton. I ain't talking about the E-says, or the saxophone tat. It's Paul.
Yeah. He used to go to writing for the bass. And that old man would write too, buddy. He could put some stuff on paper. And, and old man, Bob was on the alto.
